svg.aria-label: The disclosure mode of the paper skill. Boxes: You name the venue, and paste the policy of a venue it does not know (stop); Formatter: each kind of AI use marked, the statement as a patch (agent); You confirm each uncertain kind of AI use (stop); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
